_note: The quality ladder (docs/herbalism-revamp-plan.md §2, §4.3, §12). These are the owner-accepted starting values from 2026-10-02, tunable in play. The minigame score (0..1, from the player's hands) is spread evenly over the crafter's ladder up to their ceiling; the server, never the page, turns it into one of these indices. Each column runs 0 Crude, 1 Sound, 2 Fine, 3 Superior, 4 Flawless (the names are `worldclass.quality_name`, kept in one place). `potency` scales a product's benefits and `duration` how long they last ('stronger and longer'), `drawback` scales its harm ('softens drawbacks'), `price` its worth ('worth more'). Past Flawless the ladder runs on as Flawless +1, +2 and so on, by the `beyond` steps.
